content.title: Boston College reportedly set to hire UConn assistant Luke Murray, son of actor Bill Murray
content.text: Longtime college basketball assistant Luke Murray is getting his first head coaching job.According to ESPN, Murray, the son of legendary actor Bill Murray, is set to be the new men’s basketball coach at Boston College. He’s been an assistant coach at UConn since 2021 and played a vital role on the coaching staff as the Huskies won back-to-back national championships in 2023 and 2024.AdvertisementBoston College was looking for a coach after firing Earl Grant at the end of the season. The Eagles haven’t been to the NCAA tournament since 2009 and haven’t had a winning season since going 19-16 under coach Jim Christian in 2018.In 2025-26, Boston College went 11-20 overall and 4-14 in the ACC. The Eagles tied for next-to-last in the conference standings and failed to qualify for the ACC tournament.Draft your Yahoo Fantasy Baseball team for the 2026 MLB seasonMurray, 40, got his coaching start at Post University in 2008 and has been an assistant for UConn coach Dan Hurley at three different schools. Murray first worked for Hurley at Wagner and then was an assistant for him at Rhode Island.AdvertisementHe came to UConn in 2021 after a stint as an assistant coach at Louisville. He’s helped run the Huskies’ offense while in Storrs; UConn was fifth in the country in field goal percentage and second in assists per game during its 2024 national championship run.This season, UConn is shooting 48% from the field as a team and averaging 18.4 assists a game. The Huskies, a No. 2 seed in the NCAA tournament, play No. 3 Michigan State in the Sweet 16 on Friday night.
